problem: The definition 'a particle thrown into the air' does not cover a body projected horizontally from a height, which Section 3 itself treats as a projectile. A student may think horizontal projection is not projectile motion.
fix: Define it as: a body given an initial velocity and then moving under gravity alone (weight only, air resistance ignored), whether launched upward at an angle or horizontally from a height.

problem: Mass m appears in 'the only force is weight mg downward' but m is never defined, though every other symbol is.
fix: Add 'where m is the mass of the particle in kg' after weight mg, or write 'the only force is its weight, mg, acting downward'.

problem: 'Set y = 0 and solve' is incomplete; solve for what is not stated.
fix: Write 'Set y = 0 and solve for the time t; the non-zero root is the time of flight T.'

problem: The plotted curve runs past the landing point down to y = −0.40 m at x = 36 m, while the y-axis minimum is 0 m, so part of the drawn path is physically meaningless ground-level clipping beyond the range of 35.3 m.
fix: End the series at the landing point (x = 35.3 m, y = 0) or set the x-axis maximum to 35.3 m so the path stops at the ground.
